hero.lead: Study material on the foundations of computing and machine learning. Each concept is presented with its formal definition, its geometric reading where it has one, and its implementation.

one.title: Manipulable figures
one.body: Concepts are introduced through figures that can be manipulated, so that intuition precedes the algebraic formulation.

two.title: Definition and code
two.body: Each lesson states the formal definition alongside its corresponding implementation, keeping theory and computation together.

three.title: Freely available
three.body: The complete material is available without prior registration or restrictions.
